claim: A Strava subscription is a prerequisite for creating an app.
quote: A Strava subscription is a prerequisite for creating an app.

claim: Every new app starts in single-player mode, where only your own account can connect.
quote: All new applications start in single-player mode. This is the default state where only your own Strava account can authenticate with the app

claim: The API Policy is effective June 1, 2026.
Standard Tier apps are subject to subscription requirements.
quote: Standard Tier Applications are subject to subscription requirements as published on the Strava developer site , including a requirement that the developer or specified end users maintain an active Strava subscription.

claim: The Extended Access Tier, generally 10,000 users or more, is admitted case by case.
quote: Extended Access Tier Applications are admitted on a case-by-case basis

claim: The policy prohibits pass-through proxies and aggregators that re-expose the API.
quote: pass-through proxy, intermediary, or aggregator that re-exposes the Strava API Materials, in whole or in part, to third parties

claim: Garmin's developer program is only for business use.
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.

claim: Some metrics need a license fee or minimum device order for commercial use.
quote: Access to some metrics may require a license fee payment or minimum device order quantity for commercial use.

claim: Garmin confirms an application's status within two business days.
quote: After you request the Garmin Connect Developer Program, we will confirm the status of your application within two business days.
